name: planning-cost-benefit
description: Use when the user asks whether something is worth it, a cost-benefit analysis, ROI, TCO, NPV, IRR, payback period, build vs buy or a business case for migrating to the cloud. Produces cost and benefit tables, ROI/NPV, sensitivity analysis and a recommendation. Not for pricing your product (use product-pricing-strategy) or market sizing (use planning-market-analysis).
